function.name: _wb_create_instance
function.description: Create and start a workflow process instance. ⚠️ Must first call _wb_get_process_define to get the configuration information of the specified workflow process definition, then construct the request parameters according to the returned configuration.

appId.description: The ID of the application where the workflow module is located.

processDefineId.description: Workflow process definition ID. Note this is not the procDefId field returned from instance list.

formTableId.description: The data table module ID bound to the workflow start node. Call _wb_get_process_define first to obtain the table structure. Required when startSetting.enableStartForm is true; use startSetting.formSetting.tableId.

record.description: Start-form record data. Call _wb_get_process_define first to obtain the table structure. Required when startSetting.enableStartForm is true. Keys must be field keys, not field IDs.

varMap.description: Input variables for the process instance in key-value format; may be empty.
